entries.b1965565f5f0e4ff: Under the group's basic philosophy 'ＴＯＫＡＩ－ＷＡＹ', it aims for sustained growth by leveraging its 'customer strength', 'comprehensive strength' and 'mobility', as an enterprise that comprehensively supports its customers' daily lives. The Medium-Term Management Plan 2028, announced in May 2026 for the three years from the fiscal year ended March 2027 to the fiscal year ended March 2029, lists 'expansion of business profit' and 'strengthening of shareholder returns' as key themes. It states that it will pursue the 'Triple Accel strategy', growing three axes (area expansion, expansion of customer and contract numbers, and higher unit prices through enhanced service menus), to roll out nationwide the Shizuoka business model, which has an overwhelming share.
